pipeline_flow.name: Document Loading
pipeline_flow.description: Extracts raw text page-by-page from a PDF document.

pipeline_flow.name: Text Chunking
pipeline_flow.description: Splits text into overlapping chunks using word windows or RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter.

pipeline_flow.name: Tokenization
pipeline_flow.description: Encodes text with cl100k_base and counts tokens.

pipeline_flow.name: Embeddings & Similarity
pipeline_flow.description: Generates 384-dimensional vectors with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and compares them via cosine similarity.

pipeline_flow.name: Vector Database Persistence
pipeline_flow.description: Stores documents in a local PersistentClient collection named rag_documents.

pipeline_flow.name: End-to-End Ingestion
pipeline_flow.description: Reads PDF pages, splits into 500-char chunks with 50-char overlap, computes normalized embeddings, and upserts into ChromaDB with cosine HNSW space.

pipeline_flow.name: Prompting & LLM Generation
pipeline_flow.description: Formats structured prompt templates and invokes the OpenAI Responses API.
